_about: What each meme file is for. Looked up by file name. id: what the AI answers with. start/end: the part that is played (seconds). how: cut = the video waits while the meme fills the screen; over = sound only, over the video; end = closes the clip; later = where a long wait was cut out. auto false = never picked by itself.
